text.description_html:
American Eagle 4200 Series 38 - 48 Inch Door Commercial Vertical Rod Exit Device in Polished Brass

The PDQ American Eagle 4200 Series offers a reliable and economical solution for compliance with life safety and fire code requirements. They come with touch bar components that are constructed of heavy gauge wrought steel or stainless steel as well as metal chassis covers and end caps. Non fire rated devices come standard with hex key dogging.

Fasteners are furnished for both wood and metal door applications. Fire labeled devices are furnished standard with sex nuts. These exit devices are listed by U.L./U.L.C. and comply with U.L. 10C and UBC 7-2 (1997) for positive pressure.

Meets requirements of the Buy American Act. ADA compliant and ICC/ANSI 117.1 for accessible and usable buildings.

Features and Specifications: for PDQ 4200VA Vertical Rod Exit Device

  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Chassis: Cadmium plated steel
  • Rail: Heavy gauge steel or stainless steel
  • Touch Pad: Heavy gauge steel or stainless steel
  • Latch Bolt: Stainless steel dead locking with 5/8" throw
  • Projection: 2-5/8" projection
  • Hand: Device is non-handed
  • Dogging: Hex key dogging standard
  • Application: Surface Vertical Rod (7'0" tall door standard)
  • Stile Width: 4-1/4" minimum
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Door Width: Standard for 3'8"- 4'0" door maximum
  • Door Height: Standard Up to 7' High Door. (Optional 1' extension rod [up to 8' High Door] or 3' extension rod [up to 10' High Door] )
  • Certifications: U.L./U.L.C. 305 listed for "Panic", "Fire Exit Hardware" labeled for up to 1-1/2 hour for 3'0" x 7'0" maximum single, 6'0" x 7'0" maximum pairs / Complies with U.L. 10C and UBC 7.2 (1997)
  • Warranty: Five (5) year manufacture warranty
  • Installation Instructions: Non Fire Rated (PDF)

Sold Individually
